name: ipsEnabled
definition: True when every enabled allow rule or policy set the tool reads carries an intrusion prevention (vulnerability protection) profile, directly or through a profile group.
population: the enabled allow rules (or policy sets) the tool reads; denominator = every one read
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the policy and profile groups showing an intrusion prevention profile on every in-scope allow rule; an error, empty or possibly cut-off read is Not evaluated.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)
Public OpenAPI reference for Cloud NGFW for AWS (pan.dev/cloudngfw/aws/api/)

changeLog.change: Registered so the Palo Alto firewall transformations (hardware and cloud) can emit it. Meaning is vendor-neutral and written from public references only; no real device or customer read, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Presence of a profile, not its signature actions.
